newsitem.title: FRANCE: French trucker talks break down without agreement.
newsitem.headline: French trucker talks break down without agreement.

text.p: Talks between French truckers and employers, which aimed to resolve an 11-day strike, broke down on Wednesday without agreement, a senior union official said.
Roger Politti, of the Force Ouvriere union, told reporters as he came out of the meeting that negotiations had stopped and government mediation had ended.
"Mr Roger Cros (the government mediator) decided to put an end to his mediation mission," Politti said.
Breakdown arose from disagreement over pay rises, he said. Union sources said truckers asked for up to 23 percent pay rises but employers were only offering one percentage point.

Politti said truckers would maintain roadblocks around the country which have started to strangle the French economy. He added that employers and unions would meet on Friday to sign an agreement on some points, mostly about pension rights, which had been agreed earlier in the day.
